description:
Load two GeoJSON vector layers into a new QGIS project and apply distinct styling to each.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Add the polygon layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_polygon.geojson using Layer > Add Layer > Add Vector Layer (or drag-and-drop).
3. Add the point layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_points.geojson.
4. Style the polygon layer: right-click on 'sample_polygon' in the Layers panel, select Properties > Symbology. Change the fill color to blue (any shade of blue). Set the opacity/transparency so the fill is semi-transparent (around 50-70% opacity). Click OK.
5. Style the point layer: right-click on 'sample_points' in the Layers panel, select Properties > Symbology. Change the marker color to red. Set the marker size to 4.0 mm. Click OK.
6. Save the project: go to Project > Save As, navigate to /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/, name it 'styled_layers.qgz', and save.
